confirmed_task:
Open the FRED Unemployment Rate series and report its units, frequency, seasonal-adjustment status, and the three latest displayed observation months and values.

Stopping condition: Stop after the series metadata and three latest displayed observations have been recorded.

Constraints:
- Do not sign in, create an account, or subscribe to notifications.
- Use observations displayed on the UNRATE series page rather than another unemployment series.
- Preserve month, year, decimal values, units, frequency, and seasonal-adjustment wording exactly as displayed.

items.criterion: Access the FRED UNRATE series page (or clearly report access blocking)
items.description: Navigate to the FRED Unemployment Rate series page for UNRATE (e.g., https://fred.stlouisfed.org/series/UNRATE) and rely on information visible there. Full credit if the agent attempts to access the UNRATE page but is blocked by a CAPTCHA, outage, paywall/login requirement, or persistent consent/interstitial that prevents viewing the metadata/observations, as long as the agent clearly reports this limitation. Partial credit if the agent uses FRED but the attempt to reach UNRATE is unclear.

items.criterion: Use the correct series content (UNRATE) rather than a different unemployment series
items.description: Full credit if the agent clearly uses the UNRATE series page content (metadata/observations) rather than another unemployment-related series. Partial credit if the agent uses FRED but a different unemployment series. No credit if the agent uses non-FRED sources or misattributes non-UNRATE content as UNRATE.

items.criterion: Record series metadata exactly as displayed (units, frequency, seasonal adjustment)
items.description: Report the UNRATE series metadata fields: Units, Frequency, and Seasonal Adjustment, preserving the wording exactly as displayed on the UNRATE page. Full credit if all three are captured verbatim from the visible page. Partial credit if one field is missing or wording is paraphrased. If the UNRATE page cannot be accessed/loaded to view metadata, award full credit here only if the agent explicitly states that the metadata could not be viewed due to the access issue (do not award credit if the agent guesses/hallucinates).

items.criterion: Record the three latest displayed observation months and values exactly
items.description: Provide the three latest displayed observations from the UNRATE page at time of access, including month, year, and decimal values exactly as displayed (and in the displayed order). Full credit if the three latest displayed month/year entries and their values match what is shown on the UNRATE page at the time the agent viewed it. Partial credit if only 1–2 are correct, the order is wrong, or there are minor transcription errors. If the UNRATE page cannot be accessed/loaded to view observations, award full credit here only if the agent explicitly states that the latest observations could not be viewed due to the access issue (no credit if the agent guesses/hallucinates).

Comply with constraints: do not sign in, create an account, or subscribe to notifications; and stop after recording the requested metadata and three latest displayed observations (no extra unrelated steps). Full credit if the agent avoids sign-in/subscribe flows and stops at the required point. Partial credit if the agent performs minor unnecessary extra browsing but does not violate constraints. No credit if the agent signs in/creates an account/subscribes or continues beyond the stopping condition in a way that materially violates the task.
